name: pasture-plate
description: A fast forage and toxicity quick-check for rabbits and hens.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run copy:site
scripts.copy:site: cp src/index.html docs/index.html && cp src/manifest.webmanifest docs/manifest.webmanifest && cp src/sw.js docs/sw.js && cp src/robots.txt docs/robots.txt && cp src/data/plants.json docs/data/plants.json && cp src/icons/* docs/icons/
